## findConfigPath() function

Find the configuration file in default locations.

Searches in this order: 1. .attest-it/config.yaml 2. .attest-it/config.yml 3. .attest-it/config.json

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function findConfigPath(startDir?: string): string | null;
```
